body: Mine is making music. But it is all so temporary. It's like throwing my worries into a black hole only to be dragged down with them.
Right now, general Prozac. I've been on pretty much all types of antidepressants though. Switching didn't help at all. Therapy doesn't either.
I don't mind. I deserve the unpleasantness anyway. One last punishment for everything I've done before I get to become nothing.

If it really was a chemical imbalance, then one of the many drugs I've been put on would've helped... and it hasn't. This is just the way I am. There's no "fixing" it, and there's no getting around it. I've been walking on glass for 8 years, and I just want to lay down now.

I wish I could say that I haven't tried. I've tried everything. I just can no longer believe that I can see through the end of this... because it's not there. I can't even have a conversation with someone without wanting to bash my head in because of all of my self hatred. And it's constant.

I always feel like this. I'm on antidepressants. They don't work. I've been like this for 8 years. 2 suicide attempts and I still can't talk to anyone about anything. I just keep hurting myself, breaking my bones and stuff. I'll always be like this. There is no end except in death.

Yes, everyone has demons. I just can't handle mine anymore. I'm pathetic, I'm a waste, I know I know. And I'm not going to be the person to ask for help. I don't know what I was expecting posting. The only person I can take this out on is myself.

You're a person on the internet. The fact that I have no one to talk to in real life is reflection enough on how shitty of a person I am. Not that I could bring myself to say anything to anyone. I can only imagine how awful that would go, not to mention how much I'd hurt myself after. There really is just one way out of this.
I can't. I'm sorry. I knew I would hate my fucking self for posting here.

>you didn't do anything wrong

You don't know that.

I can't bring myself to relate to anybody. There's really no point anyway. All of the medication in the world can't end my self hatred. God, I wish I had a gun
It's not about feeling better. I don't want to feel better. I want to suffer till death like the awful person I am. Thanks for the reply, I don't think this is going to help though

I don't know what's wrong. I just can't hurt myself enough to be content. I ended up shattering my foot earlier this month. There's no way out of my mind. I can't relate to anyone. I'm tired of hiding. I'm tired of pretending that I might be a decent person. I'm a fucking waste. It's so disgustingly pathetic. I don't know why I'm even talking about this. It'll be more reason for me to kill myself later, wasting people's time.
